scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n fns,fire,web -c gray,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix functions run watch" "npm run emulators" "vite"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:start --project demo-psc --only auth,firestore,functions --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --project demo-psc-test --only auth,firestore,functions "node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test functions/test/api.test.ts"
